JNVCKM Alumni Medical Camp

Special Contribution: Medical screening and consultation by JNVCKM Alumni Doctors
body:
## JNVCKM Alumni Medical Camp

A special **Medical Camp for the students and teachers of Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya, Chickmagalur** was organised by JNVCKM alumni on **25 January 2015**.

What made this initiative particularly special was that, unlike conventional medical camps, the programme was conducted by **our own JNVCKM alumni who are medical doctors**. Around **15 alumni doctors from various medical specialisations** came together to serve their alma mater and provide medical screening and health consultations to the present students and teaching staff.

The doctors conducted health check-ups and screening for the students and teachers, helping identify health concerns and providing appropriate medical guidance. **Medicines worth ₹20,000** were also distributed to those who required them.

The programme received appreciation from the **Principal, teachers and students**. At the concluding ceremony, the school expressed its gratitude for the alumni's thoughtful initiative, and **all participating alumni doctors were felicitated by the school** in recognition of their service.

The medical camp stands as a memorable example of the JNVCKM alumni's commitment to giving back to their alma mater—not only through financial contributions, but also through their **professional expertise, time and service**.
author: Dr Sampath Kumar- President -JNVCKM Alumni Assocoiation
